{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
df_valid = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Now compute the mean of valid biomarker_baseline values
mean_valid_baseline = df_valid['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (valid values only): {mean_valid_baseline}")"}
